BoardingPal Privacy Policy

Version 2.0 · Effective October 22, 2026

1. Who We Are

Cosner Pagaddut operates BoardingPal and is responsible for your personal data. We process it under the Philippine Data Privacy Act of 2012 (RA 10173). Contact our Data Protection Officer at pagaddutcosner10@gmail.com.

2. Data We Collect

Account: email address, password (stored only as a secure hash by our authentication provider), and role. Profile: name, and optionally mobile number, school, budget and profile photo. Owners: listing details, room rates and capacity, photos, and listing contact details. Reservations: room, move-in date, optional message and status history. Also: saved listings, blocked users, reports you submit, in-app notifications, and the versions of these documents you accepted. We do not collect precise location, contacts, payment details or government IDs.

3. How We Use It

To provide the service (accounts, listings, reservations, notifications); to keep the community safe (moderation, reports, blocking, abuse limits); and to meet legal obligations. We do not sell personal data, show advertising, or make automated decisions with legal effects about you.

4. Who Can See What

Anyone, including people without an account, can see published listings: title, address, rooms, rates, photos, and the owner's display name and photo. Phone numbers and other contact details are shown only to signed-in users. When a student sends a reservation request, the student and the owner can see each other's name and phone number, and the owner can see the student's school. Unpublished listings are visible only to their owner and moderators. Moderators can access the data needed to review listings and reports, and their actions are logged.

5. Service Providers

Supabase (database, authentication, file storage and server functions; servers in Tokyo, Japan) and Brevo, operated by Sendinblue SAS, France (sending verification and password-reset codes to your email address). Your data is transferred to these providers outside the Philippines under contractual safeguards.

6. How Long We Keep Data

Account, profile, listings and saved items: until you delete them or your account. Notifications: 180 days. Reservation records: up to 2 years after they close, so the other party keeps their history; if you delete your account, your name and messages are removed from those records. Reports you filed: up to 1 year after they are closed, without your identity if you delete your account. Moderator action logs: 2 years. Backups: 7 days.

7. Deleting Your Account

In the app: Profile, Settings & privacy, Delete account, confirmed with your password. On the web without the app: https://kidungonkeil20-rgb.github.io/boardingpal/delete-account.html, using your password or a one-time code sent to your email. If you have lost access to your email, write to pagaddutcosner10@gmail.com; we will verify your request without asking for your password and complete it within 30 days. Deletion cancels your open reservations (the other party is notified), removes owners' listings and photos, and deletes your profile, photos, saved listings and notifications immediately. Limited records are kept only as described in section 6.

8. Your Rights

You have the right to be informed, to access and correct your data, to object, to erasure or blocking, to data portability, to claim damages, and to complain to the National Privacy Commission. Contact pagaddutcosner10@gmail.com; we respond within 30 days.

9. Security

Data is encrypted in transit. Access is restricted per user by database security rules, photos are stored privately and shown through short-lived links, and sensitive actions run only on our servers. No system is perfectly secure; if a breach is likely to harm you, we will notify you and the National Privacy Commission as the law requires.

10. Changes and Contact

We will ask you to accept an updated policy in the app before you continue. Contact: Cosner Pagaddut, Lagawe, Ifugao, Philippines, pagaddutcosner10@gmail.com.
